metadata.question: Did the temperature over Córdoba airport reach over 40 degrees Celcius on April 26, 2023?

data.raw_code: The question is about temperature over Córdoba airport on a specific date. I need to: 1. Use temperature data - ECMWF ERA5 would be appropriate 2. Define Córdoba airport location (Argentina: approximately -64.208, -31.323) 3. Check temperature on April 26, 2023 4. See if it reached over 40°C I'll use ECMWF ERA5 data which has 2m temperature data. The band is 'mean_2m_air_temperature' in Kelvin, so I'll need to convert to Celsius. Let me structure: - Geometry: Point for Córdoba airport - Date: April 26, 2023 - Data: ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY for daily aggregates or HOURLY for specific times - Processing: Convert from Kelvin to Celsius, check maximum temperature - Validation: Check collection size, valid pixels, and temperature range ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var cordoba_airport = ee.Geometry.Point([-64.208, -31.323]); var startDate = '2023-04-26'; var endDate = '2023-04-27'; // 2. Data Acquisition - ECMWF ERA5 for temperature var era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(cordoba_airport); // Check collection size var size = era5.size().getInfo(); print(`ERA5 Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Get temperature image and convert from Kelvin to Celsius var tempImg = era5.first().select('mean_2m_air_temperature'); var tempCelsius = tempImg.subtract(273.15); // 3. Check valid pixels var pixelCount = tempCelsius.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cordoba_airport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo(); print(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // 4. Get temperature value var maxTemp = tempCelsius.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: cordoba_airport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo(); print(`Max temperature: ${maxTemp.toFixed(1)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined || !isFinite(maxTemp)) { print("C3"); } else if (maxTemp > 60 || maxTemp < -60) { // Unrealistic temperature range print("C3"); } else if (maxTemp > 40) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
